source.notes: Typeset school paper with a real text layer (powers and fractions flattened, rebuilt from the page images). Printed header: Half Yearly Examination 2018-2019, Mathematics, Class : VIII, Time : 2Hrs.+15mins. Reading Time, Full Marks : 80 (durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed; the 15 min is labelled reading time). examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session 2018-2019. The PDF is a two-up booklet scan: PDF page 1 = printed page 1 (left half blank), PDF page 2 = printed pages 2 and 5 (Question 10), PDF pages 3 and 4 show printed pages 3 and 4 twice side by side (duplicates ignored). SECTION -A [Attempt all questions] = Questions 1–4 (40 marks); Section B (40 marks) Attempt any four questions = Questions 5–10 (10 marks each), so the pack total (100) exceeds the 80-mark maximum; no choiceGroup is set because the choice is 'any four of six'. Where a printed mark covers a group of items it is kept as one entry with that total. Paper's own wording kept ('marked ar', 'has to paid to on', '∠ABC − (3x−7)°'). No school name printed. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
